description: Measures peak half-precision (FP16) floating-point compute throughput using packed __hfma2() intrinsics on __half2 values. Each __hfma2 delivers 4 FLOPs (2 packed elements x 2 ops). Reports GFLOPS.

scaling_param.name: fmas_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of __hfma2 operations per thread per kernel invocation; controls total compute work

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid
